subject: SIG / CAIQ: recovery commitments & RTO/RPO dossier request
messages:
From: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra.ruiz@sablefin.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: security@SableFinancial.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ continuity details and RTO/RPO commitments

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — Sable's security team is assembling our SIG/CAIQ evidence set and we need to capture Redwood's operational commitments for business continuity. Two asks to start:

1) A compact "recovery commitments dossier" that summarizes RTO/RPO by service tier and region (we care most about US-west and EU). Include short descriptions of warm-cache behavior and any KV cache recovery guarantees.
2) Representative artifacts: recent RTO/RPO matrix (CSV or spreadsheet), the most recent warm-start trace (log snippet), and a short runbook excerpt that shows failover sequence for the hosted API.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will allow a short live witness session (30 min) during our SIG review? We include witnesses for a handful of vendors.

Appreciate a reply by Aug 24 if possible — we're aiming to close the SIG by end of month.

Best,
Alejandra Ruiz
Head of Vendor Security
Sable Financial

Attachment: example-sig-template.pdf (referenced)
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra.ruiz@sablefin.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ continuity details and RTO/RPO commitments

Alejandra — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to support and can provide the items you listed. High-level answers up front:

- RTO/RPO: for hosted API (standard tier) we target RTO 15 minutes and RPO 1 minute for control plane and KV-cache recovery in US-west; dedicated/private SLAs can be configured for different targets per contract.
- Warm cache behavior: our runtime persists periodic V2 snapshots of active KV caches and keeps a rolling journal for 1 hour to accelerate recovery; warm-start traces show the KV replay and prefix rehydration steps.
- Live witness: yes, we can do a 30-minute live witness. We typically run a short tabletop plus a tracing session with an ops engineer and a product reliability engineer.

I'll attach a compact dossier and the RTO/RPO matrix. Grace and Marissa are looped for runbook extracts and the warm trace.

Next steps:
1) I'll share the dossier and matrix now.
2) Grace, can you pull the recent warm-start trace and a 1-page runbook excerpt for the hosted API failover sequence?
3) Alejandra, what days/times next week work for the 30-minute witness?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_bcp_dossier_v1.pdf; rto_rpo_matrix_us-west.csv

Ben / Marissa — attaching the warm-start trace excerpt and a concise runbook snippet for the hosted API failover path. A few notes:

- The warm-start snippet is a filtered log (kv-warm-snapshot-20260801.log) showing the prefix rehydration and journal replay; it has timestamps and step markers that map to the RTO buckets in the CSV.
- Runbook excerpt (hosted-api-failover-snippet.txt) is intentionally short — it shows the detection-to-failover flow and verification checks we use for live witnesses. Full playbook is internal but we can redact ops-specific endpoints for vendor review.

From: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra.ruiz@sablefin.com>

Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, security@SableFinancial.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ continuity details and RTO/RPO commitments

Ben / Grace — thank you, received the dossier and attachments. A few clarifying Qs from our operations reviewer before we schedule the witness:

1) In the RTO/RPO matrix you flagged a 15-minute RTO for control plane incidents. Can you clarify whether that assumes automatic routing to a warm pool or a manual ops intervention?
2) For KV cache journal replay: what is the typical observed replay time for a 1M-token session during warm recovery? Any recent test numbers you can share (even summary averages) would help our assessment.

If you can respond by end of day today we'll pick a slot for the witness. Preferred days: Tue/Wed next week (Aug 25/26 morning PT).

Thanks,
Alejandra
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra.ruiz@sablefin.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ continuity details and RTO/RPO commitments

Alejandra — quick answers to the two items:

1) The 15-minute RTO is the automated warm-pool failover path for the hosted API; it does not require manual intervention for traffic routing in the common scenarios we describe in the dossier. We do have manual escalation for complex stateful restores, but those are outside the standard hosted SLA.

2) Observed journal replay times for a 1M-token load in our staging runs typically fall in the 45–90 second range for the replay step alone; end-to-end warm-start (rehydration, KV replay, verification hooks) averages 2.5–4 minutes in US-west under our test harness. We've included the summarized test CSV in the RTO/RPO matrix (rto_rpo_matrix_us-west.csv).

We can confirm availability for Tue Aug 25 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-minute witness. If that works, Ben will send the calendar invite and a short agenda.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Staff Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: test-run-summary-agg.csv (referenced)
